items.quote: assert(arts == 84 and areas == 1073 and files == 1739, "pinned build coverage changed")
items.what: A snapshot of generated-data counts. It fails on any legitimate data change, not on a defect, and it blocks the automated data refresh.
items.why: refresh-data.yml regenerates Data/Overlays.lua for a new build, then runs every spec (line 45) before create-pull-request. If Blizzard adds or changes any overlay, this assert fails the job and no refresh PR is opened for a human to review, although the PR body already asks for a manual map check. The structural checks in the same loop (lazy strings, unique keys, positive sizes, integer file IDs) already catch a broken generator. A lower bound (e.g. arts >= 84) would keep the regression guard without pinning.
items.reason: This is the pinned-build overlay completeness contract: the generator promises the full build's maps/areas/files, and per-row schema checks alone accept a valid but truncated dataset. A source omission would reduce one count while leaving all remaining rows well formed. A legitimate build update deliberately revises the integrity expectation; that does not make the test constant-equals-itself.

items.what: The wago.tools DB2 fetch-and-cache (pinned BUILD, CACHE path, --offline/--refresh, User-Agent, HTML-response check, cache write) is written five times: gen_dungeons.py:78-94, gen_zonelevels.py:96-112 (byte-identical to gen_dungeons), gen_classspells.py:62-78, gen_camp.py:33-54, gen_overlays.py:29-67; the pin `BUILD = "1.60.1.70009"` is restated in all five (refresh-data.yml:38 seds it into each file). items.why: Differences: (1) cache write is atomic in gen_overlays (write_atomic) and in gen_classspells' classicdb(), but a plain path.write_bytes in the other four copies: accidental drift, since an interrupted write leaves a truncated CSV that the next run reads from cache, and zonelevels/dungeons/classspells only check that a first row with an ID column exists, so a truncated table passes. (2) timeouts 60 / 300 / 600: drift. (3) validation: overlays checks every schema column, int-parses and rejects duplicate IDs; the rest check only ID: drift. (4) return shape (int-parsed dict, raw row list, rows grouped by a key) and gen_classspells' build parameter: intentional, per generator. tools/README.md says each generator has 'Same cache and flags as gen_overlays.py', so the docs already treat it as one mechanism. Generators run as `python3 tools/gen_x.py` while the *_test.py files import `tools.gen_*`, so the shared module needs phrases.py's `from tools.x import` pattern (and `-m` in refresh-data.yml:40) or equivalent.
items.reason: The five generators independently perform pinned DB2 download/cache/HTML validation; camp/dungeons/zone/class write cache directly while overlays uses atomic replacement. Different timeout/build arguments, schemas and parsed return shapes belong to callers, but do not require separate transport/cache mechanics. Preserve those contracts while sharing that boundary; existing generator regression tests pass. Hot/deferred; no consolidation performed.
